name: abaqus-odb-to-grid-csv
description: Convert per-case Abaqus FEA outputs into ML-ready (X, Y) wide-table CSVs. Pivots irregular FEA mesh node displacements onto a regular N×N grid via direct binning (structured mesh) or bilinear resampling, with scipy fallback for unstructured meshes. Aggregates into X_amplitude.csv + Y_grid_uz.csv.
